title: runProcess
responsibility: Executes one script or tool with explicit argv, a scrubbed process environment, bounded output, and optional cancellation.

inputs.name: runProcess.file
inputs.description: Executable or local file path used by this operation.

inputs.name: runProcess.args
inputs.description: Exact child argv without shell interpolation.

inputs.name: runProcess.options
inputs.description: Child execution or command options including bounds and optional input.

outputs.name: runProcess
outputs.description: The bounded standard output of the successful child process.
